patterns.REFLUX: B03 main BURN, reflux YES, pain NONE/MILD, chest NONE, swallow NO, vomit NO, stool-bleeding NONE, weight NO, pregnancy NO/NA; no competing constipation main domain.
patterns.UTI: Age A18_49/A50_64, anatomy FEMALE, pregnancy NO/NA, catheter NO, diabetes NO, immune NO, fever NO, flank NO, lower-abdominal pain NO, visible blood NO, recurrence NO, response EARLY/BETTER, genital association NONE; key checklist contains at least two DYSURIA/NOCTURIA/CLOUDY. Breastfeeding YES prohibits pharmacy destination: use primary care. This label is a possible pattern, not a confirmed infection.
patterns.ISOLATED_URINE: B05 main LOOK, look ONLY, key NONE, lower-abdominal pain NO, flank NO, blood NO, genital association NONE, fever NO, illness WELL, urine-output NORMAL. Existing anatomy/age risk alone does not convert isolated odour into infection.
patterns.DERMATITIS: Skin look DRY, contact YES, infection checklist NONE, surface NO, swell NO, medicine NO, systemic NO, fever NO, spread LOCAL.
patterns.CHRONIC_SKIN: Skin chronic UNCHANGED, plan ASSESSED, medicine NO, exposure NO, swell NO, surface NO, systemic NO, infection checklist NONE, fever NO, illness WELL, spread LOCAL/MOVING, course STABLE/RECURRENT, function MILD/MODERATE. This exception is a bounded authoring policy; clinical approval required.

macros.INF: active B01/B04/B05/L03, OR fever is MILD/HIGH/RIGORS, OR illness is MARKED/DECLINING, OR skin infection features contain all PAIN/HOT/SWOLLEN, OR a joint is swollen and hot, OR recovery is WOUND/DECLINE. This is a routing applicability definition, not a diagnosis of infection.
macros.PREG: pregnancy PREGNANT/POSSIBLE; `POST6` = pregnancy RECENT AND postpartum LE6. Maternity symptom rules also apply when pregnancy RECENT with an unknown postpartum interval; do not infer a safe interval.
macros.NEW_NEURO: neuro checklist contains WEAKNESS/SPEECH/NUMB/BALANCE, OR alert SPEECH, OR limb sense WEAK, OR back-leg weakness ONE/BOTH.
macros.WELL: illness WELL/TIRED, alert NONE, breath NORMAL/USUAL, skin-colour NONE, function MILD/MODERATE, course IMPROVING/STABLE/RECURRENT. Only include a component when its applicability is true; explicitly collected positive concerns remain active.
macros.SAFE(branch): every applicable safety question for that active branch is answered, every active shared/branch U1/U2 predicate is FALSE or NOT_APPLICABLE, and no unresolved safety conflict exists. “Safety question” means every question except the cause-only list below. U3 restrictions still apply before U4/U5.
macros.LOW(branch): SAFE(branch), WELL, course IMPROVING/STABLE, function MILD, plan is not CHANGED, and all applicable hydration/urine-output answers are NORMAL. Named conditions also require their exact pattern predicate. No low leaf is selected with a user-uncertain safety answer. An unchanged chronic condition may use U4 only where explicitly listed.
macros.DIARRHOEA: B04 main DIARRHOEA/BOTH. `URINARY_SYMPTOMS` = B05 main PAIN/FREQUENCY/RETENTION, OR key checklist has DYSURIA/NOCTURIA/CLOUDY, OR look CLOUDY/FREQUENCY, OR flank/blood/lower-abdominal pain YES. Colour/odour alone is not suspected infection.
macros.CHEST_ASSOC: chest association contains SPREAD/SWEAT_NAUSEA/BREATH_FAINT. `PALP_ASSOC` = palpitation association contains CHEST/BREATH/FAINT.
macros.PELVIC: L06 main PELVIC or B03 site PELVIC. `VAGINAL_BLEED` = L06 main BLEED or genital association contains BLEED. `SKIN_INF` = skin infection checklist contains all PAIN, HOT and SWOLLEN. Spreading is not a required condition for this urgent predicate.
macros.HEAD_INJURY: injury site HEAD or headache injury YES. `EYE_INJURY` = eye injury CHEMICAL/IRRITANT/HIGH_SPEED/PENETRATING/OTHER. `DURATION48` = skin time GE48, or time RECURRENT and episode duration GE48.
